title: Oxidative Stress and Cellular Protection
word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited tokens in p.teaching-prose after markup removal; all nonteaching elements excluded.
comparison: 6.C.04 verified checkpoint reported 13,056 teaching words in 141 paragraphs; this chapter has 14077 words in 157 paragraphs.
coverage: Revised CSIR-UGC-DBT 2026 and separate CSIR Life Sciences Unit 6.H; MP SET 2024 reproduced syllabus checked. All assigned 6.H.03 microtopics addressed without expanding into neighboring stress-specific nodes.
coverage_matrix: Electron transfer, radicals, ROS reaction stoichiometry
PSI electron leakage, PSII excitation, respiratory chain
Glycolate oxidase, compartmentation, apoplastic electron transfer
Lipid, protein, DNA damage and repair
Local and systemic ROS, calcium and feedback
Fluorescence, conductivity, Beer–Lambert, enzyme rates; matched controls

review.scientific: Reviewed ROS species chemistry, organellar sources, reaction balance, antioxidant routes, redox potential, injury and signaling distinctions, selected primary and review literature. Rechecked numerical questions independently: 14 nmol/min peroxide, 15 µmol/h oxygen, 12 nmol/min NADPH, Fv/Fm 0.82 and 0.65, relative leakage threefold, Michaelis–Menten 15 nmol/min, GR assay 0.20 µmol/min/mg. Original practice data explicitly illustrative. Checked answer logic and remapped answer choices without changing correct content.
review.editorial: Reviewed progression from oxygen chemistry to organelles, injury, defenses, signaling and experimental integration. Revised landmark evidence, multiple statement and time-course questions, figure labels and zoom buttons. Checked unique teaching paragraphs, anchors, headings, revision, answer explanations, canonical and JavaScript syntax.

score_basis: Internal assessment based on saved-file inspection: one mark each deducted for incomplete exhaustive reference full-text review, dense passages, no rendered SVG review, some easy distractors, and untested interactive accessibility. Not independent peer review.
limitations: Rendered desktop/mobile, keyboard and screen reader runtime not tested; figure audit is static.
Selected primary and review references checked, not an exhaustive full-text audit of all sources; MP SET via reproduced 2024 document, not independently confirmed latest official MPPSC copy.
